adaptation: Floor 1 lore anchors follow existing book-one-floor-one.json. Exact geometry, connecting corridors, doors, supply caches and storage alcoves are gameplay adaptations; this is not a canonical map.

rooms.name: Dungeon entrance and Kua-tin threshold
rooms.description: Broad carved descent to a marble landing and enormous arched Kua-tin doors. Beyond them, the first-floor route begins; exact chamber dimensions are unknown.

rooms.name: False Tutorial Guild alley
rooms.description: A misleading neon guild sign leads into the goblin Murder Dozer ambush. The alley and trap are one encounter sequence, not two separate destinations.

rooms.name: Mordecai’s Tutorial Guildhall
rooms.description: The real Tutorial Guild entrance opens to Mordecai’s personal tutorial space, with a classroom and living area. Mordecai is a guide and NPC here, not a deployable party member.

rooms.name: Hoarder’s lair / Scatterer nest
rooms.description: A round, high-ceiling room among rubbish piles and burst bags, with a grimy signed door and skull torches. The Scatterer territory belongs to this lair complex.

rooms.name: Tally’s Polish restaurant safe room
rooms.description: A Polish fast-food restaurant repurposed as a protected safe room. The children’s play area is inside this same venue. Exact chain branding and layout are not established.

rooms.name: Goblin workshop and adjoining boss chamber
rooms.description: A goblin engineering and explosives workshop connected to the War Chieftain’s chamber. Workshop equipment is an adaptation of its stated use; exact machinery and room plan are not canonical.

rooms.name: DMV waiting-room safe room
rooms.description: An Earth DMV waiting room used as a safe room, with curtained cots and an experience-cookie encounter associated with Frank and Maggie.

rooms.name: Juicer’s gym
rooms.description: A high-ceiling gym with sliding glass entry, reception turnstile, weights, benches and mats. Red combat lighting is part of the encounter presentation.

rooms.name: Sebastian’s Peruvian Taco Bell safe room
rooms.description: A converted restaurant safe room with kitchen, sleeping area, bathrooms, coffee, and Peruvian beer. Exact room layout is not established.

rooms.name: Meadow Lark encampment
rooms.description: A survivor encampment near the borough-boss stairwell. Treat its footprint as an authored camp layout; sources establish the camp and proximity, not a canonical settlement plan.

rooms.name: Ball of Swine spiral maze and stairwell
rooms.description: Rounded tunnels spiral around a courtyard, with portcullises and three bridge approaches. The final boss encounter reveals the arena and its stairwell. The switch chamber and Speedbump construction area are subregions/states, not separate destinations.

rooms.name: Abandoned service store
rooms.description: An adapted service store with sealed emergency supplies, beyond the borough boss approach.
